coaching.headline: Two majors conceded with five alive, three fights fought two-on-two, and a 1-29 river split: towers ended 0-11.
coaching.team: We lost this in the uncontested minutes. The first Fangtooth was ours at 5. Then Fangtooth at 11 and Mini Prime at 15 both fell with all five of us alive and nobody there to contest either one. Scarlett was caught alone by Countess three times before minute twelve, the first costing Mini Prime at 7.8. The fight at 16.2, won 2-1 by GRIM.exe and Maco, bought Fangtooth at 17, the only fight we converted all game. But it ran two-on-two while three lanes sat unanswered, and an outer tower, an inner tower and an inhibitor fell within the next minute. Primal Fangtooth went the same way at 22.2: GRIM.exe and Maco again alone, lost 1-2, with Scarlett and Willy both alive and never in it. The last fight, at 31.9, repeated it: Shinbi and GRIM.exe lost the Inhibitor 0-2 while Scarlett and Xeebs stood by. River control finished 1-29, towers 0-11. Next game: get five bodies to the fight, every time.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: What decided this? Two majors, Fangtooth at 11 and Mini Prime at 15, fell uncontested with all five of us alive. Then three fights were fought two-on-two, one won and two lost, while three teammates weren't in them each time. That pattern cost more than any single death.
coaching.whatWorked: The fight at 16.2: GRIM.exe and Maco killed Khaimera and Wraith 2-1, and it bought Fangtooth at 17, the only won fight cashed into a prize all game.
